persons.name: Devendra
persons.evidence: devyandrakarmmācājyena thava āṣalasena vavamacāto śenayātā hleyā julo

notes: The Newari colophon states that Devendra Karmācārya copied this hymn in his own hand (thava āṣalasena ... hleyā julo) to teach students (vavamacāto śenayātā), having obtained it from 'thava gvaṃ stikadhanikarmmācājyayāke'. It is likely that 'gvaṃstikadhani' represents gosthikā-dhani (head of the guthi) rather than a personal name, hence recorded with low confidence.
